detail: withAgentAApiBudget (scripts/agent-a-api-budget.mjs line 45-46) throws before any network call whenever body.max_output_tokens !== 800. buildSmokeRequest (this task's own contract, verified by tests/unit/scripts/smoke-deepseek-tools.test.ts) requires max_output_tokens >= 1600 for a two-round tool loop and sets it to 1600. These two already-committed interfaces are mutually exclusive: the live runner in scripts/smoke-deepseek-tools.mjs cannot reach https://api.deepseek.com/responses through the mandated budget wrapper without violating one of the two contracts.
